items.title: The influence of visual restriction and lower-limb proprioception on walking capacity in children with and without upper motor neuron lesions.
items.summary: Gait stability depends on the integration of visual and proprioceptive feedback. Children with upper motor neuron (UMN) lesions often exhibit proprioceptive deficits; however, the interaction between these deficits and visual input during walking remains unclear. This study investigated the influence of visual restriction and lower-limb proprioceptive function on walking capacity in children with UMN lesions compared to typically developing (TD) peers. In this cross-sectional study, 42 children with UMN lesions and 49 TD peers completed the 10-Meter Walk Test under normal and reduced visual conditions. We calculated absolute and relative (reduced vision/normal vision) gait capacity metrics. Proprioception was assessed at the hip, knee, and ankle using joint movement sense (JMS), joint position sense (JPS), and dynamic position sense (DPS). Spearman correlations examined relationships between proprioception and gait capacity. Both groups walked slower and took shorter steps under reduced vision; however, children with UMN lesions exhibited larger changes (p < 0.001). In these children, proprioceptive modalities showed weak-to-moderate correlations with gait parameters that strengthened under visual restriction, a pattern observed in pooled analyses. JMS showed the strongest, though weak, correlation with relative walking speed. Joint-specific analyses showed the strongest correlations at the more affected ankle and the less affected hip in children with UMN lesions. Children with UMN lesions rely more on proprioceptive input for gait under reduced vision, with the less affected hip and more affected ankle possibly compensating for deficits. Interventions targeting proprioception may enhance walking performance under varying sensory conditions.

items.titleZh: 视觉限制与下肢本体感觉对伴有和不伴有上运动神经元损伤儿童步行能力的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究比较了42名上运动神经元损伤儿童与49名典型发育儿童在正常和视觉受限条件下的步行表现。两组在视觉受限时均走得更慢、步幅更短，但上运动神经元损伤儿童的变化幅度更大，提示其更依赖本体感觉输入。本体感觉与步态参数的相关性在视觉受限时增强，且更受影响的踝关节和受影响较轻的髋关节相关性最强，可能参与代偿。研究为观察性设计，不能证明因果关系或干预疗效。
items.insight: 该研究提示上运动神经元损伤儿童在视觉输入减少时更依赖下肢本体感觉，且不同关节的代偿模式存在差异。对ALS研究者而言，这为理解上运动神经元受累患者的步态控制与感觉整合机制提供了参考，并提示本体感觉评估可能作为步行功能分层或康复靶点的探索方向，但需在ALS人群中专门验证。

aiRead.keyFinding: 上运动神经元损伤儿童在视觉受限下步行能力下降更明显，本体感觉与步态参数的相关性在视觉限制下增强，更受影响的踝关节和受影响较轻的髋关节相关性最强。
aiRead.limitation: 横断面设计无法推断因果关系；样本为儿童上运动神经元损伤人群，非ALS特异性；相关性普遍为弱至中度，解释力有限。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该团队或独立团队在ALS成人人群中重复本体感觉-步态交互评估，以及针对本体感觉的康复干预能否改善不同感觉条件下的步行表现。

items.abstractZh: 步态稳定性依赖于视觉和本体感觉反馈的整合。伴有上运动神经元（UMN）损伤的儿童常表现出本体感觉缺陷；然而，这些缺陷与视觉输入在步行过程中的相互作用仍不清楚。本研究探讨了视觉限制和下肢本体感觉功能对伴有UMN损伤儿童步行能力的影响，并与典型发育（TD）同龄人进行比较。在这项横断面研究中，42名伴有UMN损伤的儿童和49名TD同龄人在正常和视觉减弱条件下完成了10米步行测试。我们计算了绝对和相对（视觉减弱/正常视觉）步态能力指标。本体感觉在髋、膝和踝关节通过关节运动觉（JMS）、关节位置觉（JPS）和动态位置觉（DPS）进行评估。采用Spearman相关分析检验本体感觉与步态能力之间的关系。两组在视觉减弱条件下均行走更慢、步幅更短；然而，伴有UMN损伤的儿童表现出更大的变化（p < 0.001）。在这些儿童中，本体感觉模态与步态参数显示出弱至中度相关性，且在视觉限制下相关性增强，这一模式在汇总分析中观察到。JMS与相对步行速度的相关性最强，但仍为弱相关。关节特异性分析显示，在伴有UMN损伤的儿童中，相关性最强的是更受影响的踝关节和受影响较轻的髋关节。伴有UMN损伤的儿童在视觉减弱下步行更依赖本体感觉输入，受影响较轻的髋关节和更受影响的踝关节可能代偿缺陷。针对本体感觉的干预可能改善不同感觉条件下的步行表现。
items.frontierRationale: 新近发表的横断面研究聚焦上运动神经元损伤儿童视觉限制下本体感觉与步行的交互，为ALS相关上运动神经元步态障碍的感觉整合机制提供转化参考。

items.title: Protein disulphide isomerase protects against ALS/FTD phenotypes associated with cyclin F in zebrafish and cellular models.
items.summary: Mutations in CCNF , encoding cyclin F, cause a small proportion of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) cases. Mutant cyclin F mislocalises from the nucleus to the cytoplasm, impairs the ubiquitin proteasome system, disrupts endoplasmic reticulum (ER) to Golgi transport, and triggers ER stress and apoptosis. Protein disulphide isomerase (PDI), a redox-active ER chaperone of the thioredoxin superfamily, protects against ALS phenotypes induced by mutant SOD1, TDP-43, and FUS, but its activity against mutant cyclin F has not been examined. To test whether PDI overexpression prevents the cellular and behavioural phenotypes induced by the ALS/FTD-associated cyclin F S621G mutation. Neuro-2a cells were co-transfected with mCherry-tagged wild-type or mutant cyclin F S621G and V5-tagged PDI or empty vector. Subcellular localisation, XBP-1 and CHOP activation, proteasome reporter (GFPu) accumulation, nuclear morphology, and cleaved caspase-3 immunoreactivity were assessed by confocal microscopy. Transient transgenic zebrafish larvae generated by mRNA co-injection of cyclin F and PDI were assessed by photomotor response at 48 h post-fertilisation. Mutant cyclin F S621G induced cytoplasmic mislocalisation, ER stress (assessed by XBP-1 and CHOP activation), proteasome dysfunction (indicated by GFPu accumulation), and apoptosis (assessed by nuclear condensation and caspase-3 activation), all of which were significantly attenuated by PDI co-expression. Zebrafish larvae expressing cyclin F S621G swam significantly shorter distances than uninjected or wildtype controls, and co-expression of PDI restored motor function to near-wildtype levels. PDI protects against ALS/FTD-associated mutant cyclin F in both cellular and in vivo zebrafish models, identifying PDI as a redox-based therapeutic target for CCNF -linked ALS/FTD.
items.titleZh: 蛋白质二硫键异构酶在斑马鱼和细胞模型中保护免受与细胞周期蛋白F相关的ALS/FTD表型
items.summaryZh: 该研究在Neuro-2a细胞和斑马鱼模型中测试了蛋白质二硫键异构酶（PDI）对ALS/FTD相关细胞周期蛋白F S621G突变的保护作用。结果显示，PDI共表达可显著减轻突变型细胞周期蛋白F引起的细胞质错误定位、内质网应激、蛋白酶体功能障碍和细胞凋亡，并改善斑马鱼幼鱼的游动缺陷。研究提示PDI是CCNF相关ALS/FTD的潜在治疗靶点，但尚属临床前动物/细胞实验阶段。
items.insight: CCNF突变是ALS/FTD中相对少见但机制独特的亚型，涉及核定位、泛素蛋白酶体系统和内质网应激的交叉通路。该研究首次在细胞和斑马鱼模型中验证PDI对突变型细胞周期蛋白F的保护作用，为这一缺乏靶向干预的遗传亚型提供了可检验的氧化还原相关靶点，值得关注后续的机制验证和转化研究。

aiRead.studyType: 临床前细胞与斑马鱼模型研究
aiRead.keyFinding: PDI共表达可显著减轻突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G诱导的细胞质错误定位、内质网应激、蛋白酶体功能障碍和凋亡，并恢复斑马鱼幼鱼运动功能至接近野生型水平。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅基于Neuro-2a细胞和瞬时转基因斑马鱼模型，尚未在哺乳动物体内或患者来源模型中验证，PDI过表达的长期安全性和靶点特异性也未评估。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续值得关注PDI在CCNF突变哺乳动物模型中的验证、PDI活性调节剂的开发，以及该通路是否与其他ALS相关蛋白（如TDP-43、SOD1、FUS）的内质网应激机制存在共享靶点。

items.abstractZh: 编码细胞周期蛋白F的CCNF基因突变导致一小部分肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）病例。突变型细胞周期蛋白F从细胞核错误定位到细胞质，损害泛素蛋白酶体系统，破坏内质网（ER）至高尔基体运输，并触发内质网应激和细胞凋亡。蛋白质二硫键异构酶（PDI）是硫氧还蛋白超家族中一种具有氧化还原活性的内质网伴侣蛋白，可保护免受突变型SOD1、TDP-43和FUS诱导的ALS表型，但其针对突变型细胞周期蛋白F的活性尚未被研究。为检验PDI过表达是否能预防ALS/FTD相关细胞周期蛋白F S621G突变诱导的细胞和行为表型。将mCherry标记的野生型或突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G与V5标记的PDI或空载体共转染Neuro-2a细胞。通过共聚焦显微镜评估亚细胞定位、XBP-1和CHOP激活、蛋白酶体报告基因（GFPu）积累、核形态和切割型caspase-3免疫反应性。通过mRNA共注射细胞周期蛋白F和PDI生成的瞬时转基因斑马鱼幼鱼，在受精后48小时通过光运动反应进行评估。突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G诱导细胞质错误定位、内质网应激（通过XBP-1和CHOP激活评估）、蛋白酶体功能障碍（通过GFPu积累指示）和细胞凋亡（通过核浓缩和caspase-3激活评估），所有这些均被PDI共表达显著减弱。表达细胞周期蛋白F S621G的斑马鱼幼鱼游动距离显著短于未注射或野生型对照，而PDI共表达使运动功能恢复至接近野生型水平。PDI在细胞和体内斑马鱼模型中均保护免受ALS/FTD相关突变型细胞周期蛋白F的影响，将PDI确定为CCNF相关ALS/FTD的基于氧化还原的治疗靶点。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年报道，首次在细胞和斑马鱼模型中证明PDI可对抗CCNF相关ALS/FTD表型，具有明确的ALS遗传亚型相关性和氧化还原靶点转化价值。

items.title: Combined γ-oryzanol and α-lipoic acid treatment suppresses inflammation and apoptosis in hSOD1 G93A models of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis via the AKT/GSK3β pathway.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease with complex pathogenic mechanisms, and the efficacy of single-target interventions remains limited. γ-Oryzanol (Orz) and α-lipoic acid (ALA) exert neuroprotective effects individually, yet their combined effects and molecular mechanisms in ALS remain unclear. To investigate the therapeutic effects and mechanisms of combined Orz and ALA treatment in ALS. Network pharmacology was used to identify potential targets shared by the compounds and ALS. Core targets and pathways were identified through protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis, molecular docking, and functional enrichment analysis, followed by experimental validation in hSOD1 G93A cell and transgenic mouse models. Six core targets (EGFR, AKT1, HSP90AA1, BCL2, SRC, HSP90AB1) were identified. In hSOD1 G93A cells, combined treatment modulated mRNA expression and protein phosphorylation of the core targets and attenuated cellular injury. In hSOD1 G93A transgenic mice, the combination delayed disease progression, prolonged survival, improved motor function, and reduced motor neuron loss. This combination alleviated inflammation and apoptosis by activating the AKT/GSK3β pathway. Combined Orz and ALA treatment modulates core targets, activates the AKT/GSK3β pathway, and suppresses inflammation and apoptosis. This combination represents a promising therapeutic strategy for ALS.
items.titleZh: γ-谷维素与α-硫辛酸联合治疗通过AKT/GSK3β通路抑制hSOD1 G93A肌萎缩侧索硬化模型中的炎症与凋亡
items.summaryZh: 该研究在网络药理学预测基础上，于hSOD1 G93A细胞和转基因小鼠中验证了γ-谷维素与α-硫辛酸联合治疗的效果：联合用药可调节EGFR、AKT1、BCL2等核心靶点，激活AKT/GSK3β通路，减轻炎症与凋亡；在小鼠中延缓疾病进展、延长生存期、改善运动功能并减少运动神经元丢失。上述结果来自动物和细胞实验，尚不能等同于临床疗效。
items.insight: 该研究为SOD1相关ALS提供了一种基于已上市或易得天然化合物的联合干预思路，并给出AKT/GSK3β这一可检验的机制轴；对关注SOD1模型治疗策略、组合疗法及转化研究的ALS研究者具有跟踪价值，但需注意其证据仍停留在细胞与小鼠层面。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，致病机制复杂，单靶点干预的疗效仍然有限。γ-谷维素（Orz）和α-硫辛酸（ALA）各自具有神经保护作用，但二者联合在ALS中的效应及分子机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在探讨Orz与ALA联合治疗在ALS中的治疗效应及机制。研究采用网络药理学识别两种化合物与ALS共享的潜在靶点，通过蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）网络分析、分子对接和功能富集分析确定核心靶点与通路，随后在hSOD1 G93A细胞和转基因小鼠模型中进行实验验证。研究识别出六个核心靶点（EGFR、AKT1、HSP90AA1、BCL2、SRC、HSP90AB1）。在hSOD1 G93A细胞中，联合治疗调节了核心靶点的mRNA表达和蛋白磷酸化，并减轻了细胞损伤。在hSOD1 G93A转基因小鼠中，联合治疗延缓了疾病进展、延长了生存期、改善了运动功能并减少了运动神经元丢失。该联合治疗通过激活AKT/GSK3β通路减轻炎症和凋亡。结论：Orz与ALA联合治疗可调节核心靶点、激活AKT/GSK3β通路并抑制炎症和凋亡，该联合方案是ALS的一种有前景的治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 新近研究在hSOD1 G93A细胞和小鼠中揭示γ-谷维素与α-硫辛酸联合经AKT/GSK3β通路发挥神经保护作用，为ALS组合干预提供了可转化的候选策略。

items.title: Black Myrobalan ( Terminalia chebula ) as a potential multitarget neuroprotective agent: Translational insights and future directions in neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary: Myrobalan or Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula Retz. ) has been integrated into Ayurvedic, Unani, and even Tibetan medicine systems for over 2000 years. The "King of Medicines" has traditionally been used for diverse ailments such as digestive issues, wound healing, and general body strengthening. Now, modern medicine is focusing on the myrobalan's potential neuroprotective properties and its use in Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, Huntington's, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) neurodegenerative disorders. These ailments are characterized by some combination of enduring oxidative damage, mitochondrial dysfunction, neuroinflammation, irregular protein aggregation, and progressive neuron cell death. Most of the current treatment options revolve around addressing the symptoms of the diseases, which is insufficient as the underlying disease continues to progress. There is an urgent need to devise therapies that work simultaneously on multiple disease pathways. Some of the noted secondary metabolites in T. chebula include hydrolyzable tannins like chebulinic and chebulagic acid as well as corilagin. Others occur as phenolic acids such as gallic and ellagic acid and flavonoids quercetin and kaempferol. Moreover, glycosides, sterols, and a wide range of alkaloids are also present. A number of these compounds are known to possess multifunctional biological properties like scavenging ROS, activating Nrf2/ARE signaling, downregulating pro-inflammatory mediators through blockade of NF-κB, and exerting protective effects on the mitochondria, as well as modulating apoptosis via Bcl-2 and caspases. T. chebula extracts and some isolated compounds have also been shown to improve cognitive function, reduce neuroinflammation, and protect dopaminergic neurons, and ameliorate neurotoxic effects of amyloid-β or α-synuclein through in vitro and in vivo animal studies. A review of the contributions from the phytochemistry, mechanism of action, preclinical, translational, and adjunctive applications of Terminalia chebula in neurodegenerative disease therapy is presented here.
items.evidenceLevel: 综述/荟萃分析（叙述性综述，临床前证据为主）
items.titleZh: 诃子（Terminalia chebula）作为潜在的多靶点神经保护剂：神经退行性疾病中的转化研究启示与未来方向
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了诃子（Terminalia chebula）及其活性成分（如诃子酸、柯里拉京、没食子酸、槲皮素等）在神经退行性疾病中的多靶点神经保护潜力。文章指出，这些成分在体外和动物实验中可清除活性氧、激活Nrf2/ARE通路、抑制NF-κB介导的神经炎症、保护线粒体并调节凋亡，部分提取物还改善认知、保护多巴胺能神经元并减轻Aβ或α-突触核蛋白毒性。但现有证据主要来自临床前研究，尚未在ALS患者中证实疗效。
items.insight: ALS目前缺乏能同时干预氧化应激、神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍和蛋白聚集的多靶点疗法。诃子及其活性成分在临床前模型中显示出覆盖上述多条通路的潜力，且具有长期传统用药背景，值得作为辅助治疗或先导化合物来源进行跟踪。但需注意，该文为综述，不提供新的ALS临床数据，后续应关注其活性成分在ALS模型中的剂量、暴露和安全性数据，以及是否推进到正式临床试验。

aiRead.studyType: 叙述性综述，汇总植物化学、体外和动物研究证据
aiRead.keyFinding: 诃子提取物及诃子酸、柯里拉京、没食子酸、槲皮素等成分在临床前研究中显示抗氧化、抗神经炎症、线粒体保护和抗蛋白聚集等多靶点神经保护作用，但尚无ALS临床疗效证据。

items.abstractZh: 诃子（Myrobalan 或 Haritaki，Terminalia chebula Retz.）已被纳入阿育吠陀、尤纳尼乃至藏医药体系超过2000年。这种“药物之王”传统上用于治疗消化系统问题、伤口愈合和增强体质等多种病症。如今，现代医学正关注诃子的潜在神经保护特性及其在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）等神经退行性疾病中的应用。这些疾病的特征包括持续性氧化损伤、线粒体功能障碍、神经炎症、异常蛋白聚集和进行性神经元细胞死亡的不同组合。目前大多数治疗方案主要针对疾病症状，这并不充分，因为 underlying disease 仍在持续进展。迫切需要设计能同时作用于多条疾病通路的疗法。T. chebula 中已注意到的一些次级代谢产物包括可水解鞣质，如诃子酸（chebulinic acid）和诃黎勒酸（chebulagic acid）以及柯里拉京（corilagin）。其他还包括酚酸类如没食子酸和鞣花酸，以及黄酮类槲皮素和山奈酚。此外，还含有糖苷、甾醇和多种生物碱。其中许多化合物已知具有多功能生物学特性，如清除ROS、激活Nrf2/ARE信号通路、通过阻断NF-κB下调促炎介质、对线粒体发挥保护作用，以及通过Bcl-2和caspases调节凋亡。T. chebula 提取物和一些分离化合物在体外和体内动物研究中还显示可改善认知功能、减少神经炎症、保护多巴胺能神经元，并改善淀粉样蛋白-β或α-突触核蛋白的神经毒性作用。本文综述了 Terminalia chebula 在神经退行性疾病治疗中的植物化学、作用机制、临床前、转化和辅助应用方面的贡献。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近系统整合了诃子多靶点神经保护机制与转化前景，虽非ALS临床突破，但为开发针对ALS多重病理通路的辅助干预提供了可检验的临床前假设。

items.title: Brain-computer interfaces for neurodegenerative diseases: A comprehensive review of closed-loop systems from diagnosis to neural rehabilitation.
items.summary: Brain-computer interface (BCI) technology serves as an important bridge between the nervous system and external devices and has shown considerable promise for the diagnosis and treatment of neurodegenerative diseases, whose global burden continues to increase: in 2021, more than 57 million people were living with dementia worldwide, with Alzheimer's disease (AD) accounting for approximately 60-70% of cases, while an estimated 11.77 million people were living with Parkinson's disease (PD) in 2021, according to the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021. This growing disease burden, together with the progressive loss of cognitive, motor, and communicative functions, highlights the need for more precise approaches to early detection, functional assistance, and individualized intervention. Conventional diagnostic and therapeutic approaches remain poorly suited to early detection and timely intervention. This paper analyzes the development of BCI technology, from the first detection of electroencephalogram (EEG) signals to the parallel development of invasive and non-invasive systems, and outlines the basic principles of signal acquisition, processing, and decoding, together with the relative advantages and limitations of different approaches. It then focuses on the use of BCI in Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), covering early diagnosis, functional reconstruction, and neuromodulation. The article also discusses the difficulties encountered by BCI technology in terms of technological realization, clinical translation, and ethical considerations, as well as several future research directions, including multimodal fusion, adaptive algorithms, closed-loop control systems, and personalized treatment so as to drive the applications of BCI in precision medicine and in neurological diseases.

items.abstractZh: 脑机接口（BCI）技术是连接神经系统与外部设备的重要桥梁，在神经退行性疾病的诊断和治疗方面展现出可观前景，而此类疾病的全球负担持续加重：根据2021年全球疾病负担研究，2021年全球有超过5700万人患有痴呆症，其中阿尔茨海默病（AD）约占60-70%；同年估计有1177万人患有帕金森病（PD）。疾病负担不断增长，加之认知、运动和交流功能的进行性丧失，凸显了对更精准的早期检测、功能辅助和个体化干预方法的需求。传统诊断和治疗方法仍难以满足早期检测和及时干预的需要。本文分析了BCI技术的发展历程，从首次检测到脑电图（EEG）信号到侵入式与非侵入式系统的并行发展，并概述了信号采集、处理和解码的基本原理，以及不同方法的相对优势和局限性。随后重点讨论了BCI在阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中的应用，涵盖早期诊断、功能重建和神经调控。文章还讨论了BCI技术在技术实现、临床转化和伦理考量方面遇到的困难，以及若干未来研究方向，包括多模态融合、自适应算法、闭环控制系统和个体化治疗，以推动BCI在精准医学和神经系统疾病中的应用。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了闭环BCI在ALS等神经退行性疾病中从诊断到神经康复的应用框架，并指出多模态融合与自适应闭环控制等转化方向。

items.title: Dysfunction of the blood-brain barrier and neurovascular unit in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis - From advanced human models to treatments.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder, characterized by the degeneration of motor neurons, resulting in progressive and eventually complete loss of motor function. The phenotypical heterogeneity of ALS poses a challenge to early diagnosis and treatment, with currently available therapeutics only capable of relieving symptoms and slowing progression. While ALS is classified as a motor neuron disease (MND), research has identified significant impairment to the blood-brain barrier (BBB) and neurovascular unit (NVU) of ALS patients. The BBB along with supporting cells of the NVU selectively control the entry of substances into the central nervous system (CNS) and maintain brain homeostasis, with its many cellular components demonstrating impaired function, specifically relating to inflammation, oxidative stress and TDP-43 proteinopathy. The advent of more advanced in vitro techniques as well as use of patient-derived BBB cells has presented a promising alternative to recreate the in vivo structure of the BBB/NVU in a highly controlled platform. Such approaches have ranged from simple 2-dimensional (2D) cell culture to intricate 3-dimensional (3D) co-culture systems, as well as microfluidic systems and organoids, with a potential to investigate ALS associated BBB/NVU dysfunction and drug discovery. This review provides a comprehensive assessment of known BBB/NVU dysfunction in ALS and methods of investigating this using in vitro and in vivo platforms with a focus on inflammation, oxidative stress and pathological TDP-43 expression. This review also presents a future perspective to overcoming barriers to treatment of ALS using new patient-derived BBB/NVU model systems.

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，以运动神经元变性为特征，导致运动功能进行性并最终完全丧失。ALS的表型异质性给早期诊断和治疗带来挑战，目前可用的治疗手段仅能缓解症状并延缓进展。虽然ALS被归类为运动神经元病（MND），但研究已发现ALS患者的血脑屏障（BBB）和神经血管单元（NVU）存在显著损伤。BBB连同NVU的支持细胞选择性控制物质进入中枢神经系统（CNS）并维持脑稳态，其多种细胞组分表现出功能受损，尤其涉及炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病。更先进的体外技术的出现以及患者来源BBB细胞的使用，为在高度可控平台上重建BBB/NVU的体内结构提供了有前景的替代方案。此类方法从简单的二维（2D）细胞培养到复杂的三维（3D）共培养系统，以及微流控系统和类器官，具有研究ALS相关BBB/NVU功能障碍和药物发现的潜力。本综述全面评估了ALS中已知的BBB/NVU功能障碍，以及利用体外和体内平台研究这一问题的方法，重点关注炎症、氧化应激和病理性TDP-43表达。本综述还提出了利用新的患者来源BBB/NVU模型系统克服ALS治疗障碍的未来展望。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述聚焦患者来源BBB/NVU先进模型在ALS机制研究与药物发现中的转化潜力，具有明确的新近方法学相关性。

items.title: A replicated astrocyte long non-coding RNA signature of Alzheimer's disease is inverted in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Reactive astrocyte transitions are central to neurological disease, yet their long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) regulators remain poorly defined, and single-nucleus studies frequently treat nuclei rather than donors as replicates. This study analyses publicly available human single-nucleus RNA sequencing from four disorders using donors as the unit of inference throughout: Alzheimer's disease (AD; middle temporal gyrus, 88 donors), C9orf72-associated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and ALS/frontotemporal dementia (ALS; frontal cortex), multiple sclerosis (MS; cortex and white matter), and major depressive disorder (MDD; amygdala). The public MDD release pools nuclei by condition, so that arm cannot support donor-level inference and is exploratory only. Covariate-adjusted pseudobulk analysis of 70,009 CE astrocytes, controlling for sex, age at death and assay chemistry, identified 1,019 down-regulated autosomal lncRNAs after sex-chromosome transcripts were removed. This signature was not attributable to astrocyte subtype composition, which did not differ between groups, and 99.9% of members remained down-regulated within the dominant homeostatic subtype alone. The signature replicated in an independent AD cohort (32 of 41 testable members concordant; resampling P < 0.0001). Testing it outside AD gave a directional result: it was concordant in the MS discovery cohort (P < 0.0001) but inconclusive in an independent MS cohort in which the transcripts lay near the detection floor, and it was reproducibly inverted in ALS, in the C9orf72 discovery cohort and in an independent motor-cortex cohort not restricted to C9orf72 carriers. The inversion survived negative controls for global normalisation and expression level. These astrocyte lncRNA changes are therefore disorder-specific rather than pan-neuroinflammatory.

items.abstractZh: 反应性星形胶质细胞转变是神经系统疾病的核心环节，但其长链非编码RNA（lncRNA）调控因子仍定义不清，且单核研究常以细胞核而非供体作为重复单位。本研究分析四种疾病的公开人类单核RNA测序数据，全程以供体作为推断单位：阿尔茨海默病（AD；颞中回，88名供体）、C9orf72相关肌萎缩侧索硬化及ALS/额颞叶痴呆（ALS；额叶皮层）、多发性硬化（MS；皮层和白质）以及重性抑郁障碍（MDD；杏仁核）。公开的MDD数据按疾病状态合并细胞核，因此该组无法支持供体水平推断，仅作探索性分析。对70,009个CE星形胶质细胞进行协变量校正的伪批量分析，控制性别、死亡年龄和检测化学，在去除性染色体转录本后鉴定出1,019个下调的常染色体lncRNA。该特征不能归因于星形胶质细胞亚型组成，因为组间亚型组成无差异，且99.9%的成员仅在优势稳态亚型内仍保持下调。该特征在独立AD队列中重复（41个可测试成员中32个一致；重采样P < 0.0001）。在AD之外测试该特征得到方向性结果：在MS发现队列中一致（P < 0.0001），但在一个独立MS队列中因转录本接近检测下限而无法得出结论；在ALS中该特征可重复地倒置，包括C9orf72发现队列和一个不限于C9orf72携带者的独立运动皮层队列。该倒置在全局标准化和表达水平的阴性对照中仍然存在。因此，这些星形胶质细胞lncRNA变化是疾病特异性的，而非泛神经炎症性的。

items.title: Annexin A1 inhibits neuronal apoptosis in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis by restraining the Hippo pathway.
items.summary: Annexin A1 (ANXA1) is a multifunctional regulatory protein involved in neuroinflammation and cellular homeostasis, but its role in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) remains unclear. In this study, we investigated the relationship between ANXA1 and Hippo pathway signaling in ALS. Bioinformatic analysis of transcriptomic data from iPSC-derived motor neurons showed that ANXA1 expression was reduced in ALS and associated with apoptosis and Hippo pathway-related changes. Decreased ANXA1 expression was confirmed in hSOD1^G93A transgenic mice and NSC34 motor neuron-like cells. Phosphorylation levels of MST1/2, LATS1/2, and YAP1 were elevated, indicates activation of the Hippo pathway. Functional experiments showed that ANXA1 overexpression reduced Hippo pathway activation, enhanced cell viability, and decreased apoptosis, as increased Bcl-2 expression and reduced Bax and cleaved caspase-9 levels. In contrast, ANXA1 knockdown further activated Hippo pathway and aggravated apoptotic changes. These findings identify ANXA1 as an upstream regulator associated with Hippo pathway activation in ALS and suggest that the ANXA1/Hippo axis may represent a potential therapeutic target.
items.titleZh: 膜联蛋白A1通过抑制Hippo通路抑制肌萎缩侧索硬化中的神经元凋亡
items.summaryZh: 该研究在ALS细胞和SOD1^G93A小鼠模型中发现ANXA1表达下降，同时Hippo通路被激活。过表达ANXA1可抑制Hippo通路、提高细胞存活并减少凋亡；敲低ANXA1则产生相反效应。作者据此提出ANXA1/Hippo轴可能是ALS的潜在治疗靶点。

items.abstractZh: 膜联蛋白A1（ANXA1）是一种参与神经炎症和细胞稳态的多功能调节蛋白，但其在肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中的作用尚不清楚。本研究探讨了ALS中ANXA1与Hippo通路信号传导的关系。对iPSC来源运动神经元转录组数据的生物信息学分析显示，ALS中ANXA1表达降低，并与凋亡及Hippo通路相关变化有关。在hSOD1^G93A转基因小鼠和NSC34运动神经元样细胞中证实了ANXA1表达下降。MST1/2、LATS1/2和YAP1的磷酸化水平升高，提示Hippo通路激活。功能实验显示，ANXA1过表达可降低Hippo通路激活、增强细胞活力并减少凋亡，表现为Bcl-2表达增加以及Bax和cleaved caspase-9水平降低。相反，ANXA1敲低进一步激活Hippo通路并加重凋亡改变。这些发现表明ANXA1是与ALS中Hippo通路激活相关的上游调节因子，并提示ANXA1/Hippo轴可能是一个潜在的治疗靶点。

items.title: Exploring shared genetic pathways and gene interplay in major neurodegenerative diseases: a comprehensive review.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases are progressive disorders that involve the loss and dysfunction of neurons. Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, Huntington's disease, Frontotemporal dementia are examples of diseases. While different clinically, these disorders have a common genetic, molecular and cellular basis. This review examines the common genetic pathways, along with the interactions between genes of major neurodegenerative diseases, with a focus on the key genes, such as APOE, SNCA, MAPT, TARDBP, LRRK2 and HTT. The common pathogenic mechanisms considered to play a major role in disease progression include protein misfolding and aggregation, mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, diminished autophagy, and impaired lysosomal function, as well as synaptic degeneration. The review also emphasizes the role of systems biology strategies, such as genome-wide association studies, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, interactome analysis, and multi-omics integration, to unveiling complex molecular networks in neurodegeneration. Furthermore, the emerging biomarker strategies and therapeutic strategies targeting convergence signaling pathways including NF-κB, PI3K-Akt-mTOR, MAPK and Wnt/β-catenin are summarized. The common genetic basis and the cross-connecting molecular mechanisms of the various neurodegenerative diseases could help in the discovery of new biomarkers and pan-therapeutic targets. Further advances in molecular genetics, computational biology and precision medicine are needed to enhance early detection and the creation of effective disease-modifying treatments.
items.titleZh: 探索重大神经退行性疾病中的共享遗传通路与基因相互作用：一项综合综述
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、ALS、亨廷顿病和额颞叶痴呆之间共享的遗传通路与基因互作，重点基因包括APOE、SNCA、MAPT、TARDBP、LRRK2和HTT。文章归纳了蛋白质错误折叠与聚集、线粒体功能障碍、氧化应激、神经炎症、自噬与溶酶体功能受损、突触变性等共同致病机制，并讨论了GWAS、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学、相互作用组和多组学整合等系统生物学方法，以及针对NF-κB、PI3K-Akt-mTOR、MAPK和Wnt/β-catenin通路的生物标志物与治疗策略。作者认为，跨疾病的共同遗传基础可能支持发现新的生物标志物和泛治疗靶点，但仍需分子遗传学、计算生物学和精准医学的进一步进展。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇综述的价值在于把ALS放在跨神经退行性疾病的共同遗传与分子框架中审视：TARDBP（TDP-43）与MAPT、SNCA、LRRK2、HTT、APOE并列讨论，提示蛋白质稳态、自噬-溶酶体、线粒体和神经炎症等通路可能是跨疾病的汇聚点。它有助于研究者从泛神经退行性角度寻找可复用的生物标志物候选和共享治疗靶点，但作为综述不提供新的原始数据或疗效证据。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病是涉及神经元丢失和功能障碍的进行性疾病。阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化、亨廷顿病、额颞叶痴呆均属此类疾病。尽管临床表现不同，这些疾病具有共同的遗传、分子和细胞基础。本综述考察重大神经退行性疾病的共同遗传通路及基因间相互作用，重点关注APOE、SNCA、MAPT、TARDBP、LRRK2和HTT等关键基因。被认为在疾病进展中起主要作用的共同致病机制包括蛋白质错误折叠与聚集、线粒体功能障碍、氧化应激、神经炎症、自噬减弱、溶酶体功能受损以及突触变性。综述还强调了系统生物学策略的作用，如全基因组关联研究、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学、相互作用组分析和多组学整合，以揭示神经退行性变中的复杂分子网络。此外，本文总结了针对NF-κB、PI3K-Akt-mTOR、MAPK和Wnt/β-catenin等汇聚信号通路的新兴生物标志物策略和治疗策略。多种神经退行性疾病的共同遗传基础和交叉连接的分子机制有助于发现新的生物标志物和泛治疗靶点。分子遗传学、计算生物学和精准医学的进一步进展对于增强早期检测和开发有效的疾病修饰治疗是必要的。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，整合多组学与系统生物学视角，聚焦ALS与其他重大神经退行性疾病的共享遗传通路和汇聚信号节点，具有跨疾病靶点发现与转化参考价值。

items.title: Guam disease features chronic traumatic encephalopathy-like tau seeds in brain and spinal cord.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis/parkinsonism-dementia complex (ALS/PDC) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder that was once hyperendemic in the island of Guam (Mariana Islands, US) and a few other Pacific locales. Despite extensive investigations into its origins, the etiology of ALS/PDC remains unclear. ALS/PDC is, at the neuropathology level, characterized by tau-dominant multiple proteinopathy in brain and spinal cord. It was recently reported that Guam ALS/PDC brain extracts exhibit tau seeding activity in fluorescence resonance energy transfer (FRET)-based biosensor cells. To build upon those findings and explore the nature of tau seeds in ALS/PDC in more detail, we used an alanine mutational scanning (Ala scan) approach to determine the seeding profile of tau in nervous tissues of Guam ALS/PDC cases. First, we confirmed the detection of tau seeding activity in ALS/PDC brain samples in tau biosensor cells. Notably, we could also detect potent tau seeding activity in spinal cord. Subsequent Ala scan assays demonstrated that ALS/PDC tau displays an aggregate incorporation pattern that resembles that of chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE)-type tau. This result is consistent with recent electron cryo-microscopy studies of tau, which revealed that ALS/PDC tau filaments are predominantly of the CTE-type. The structural characteristics and seeding behaviour of ALS/PDC tau, as well as the regional distribution of tau pathology at post-mortem, suggest that ALS/PDC is a CTE-like tauopathy.

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化/帕金森综合征-痴呆复合征（ALS/PDC）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，曾在关岛（美国马里亚纳群岛）及少数其他太平洋地区呈高度地方性流行。尽管对其起源进行了广泛研究，ALS/PDC的病因仍不清楚。在神经病理学层面，ALS/PDC的特征是脑和脊髓中以tau为主的多蛋白病变。近期有报道称，关岛ALS/PDC脑提取物在基于荧光共振能量转移（FRET）的生物传感器细胞中表现出tau种子活性。为在此基础上进一步探索ALS/PDC中tau种子的性质，我们采用丙氨酸突变扫描（Ala扫描）方法，确定关岛ALS/PDC病例神经组织中tau的种子特征。首先，我们在tau生物传感器细胞中确认了ALS/PDC脑样本中tau种子活性的检测。值得注意的是，我们还能在脊髓中检测到强效的tau种子活性。随后的Ala扫描实验表明，ALS/PDC tau呈现的聚集体掺入模式类似于慢性创伤性脑病（CTE）型tau。这一结果与近期tau的电子冷冻显微镜研究一致，该研究揭示ALS/PDC tau纤维主要为CTE型。ALS/PDC tau的结构特征和种子行为，以及死后tau病理的区域分布，提示ALS/PDC是一种CTE样tau病变。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了关岛ALS/PDC中tau种子具有CTE样特征，为ALS相关tau病变的机制分型提供了转化研究线索。

items.title: Breathing in an Accelerated World: Temporality, Ethical Repertoires, and Medical Students' Examination Texts on Advanced Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Medical students are commonly examined on ethically difficult clinical decisions, yet examination scripts have rarely been treated as a distinct empirical object in medical humanities. This article analyses 61 anonymised written examination responses from Danish medical students addressing acute respiratory failure in a fictional patient with advanced amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). The study is framed as a genre analysis of examination texts, operationalised through repeated close reading, inductive coding of recurrent textual moves, and abductive interpretation through Hartmut Rosa's concepts of acceleration and resonance. Four ethical repertoires were identified: accelerated stabilisation; prognostic triage and the limit of intervention; distributed responsibility and the search for a legitimate pause; and fragile resonance through attention to wishes, dignity, and palliative alternatives. Across the corpus, students wrote judgement through temporal distinctions between urgency and delay, reversibility and progression, and escalation and proportionate limitation. The findings do not show professionalism as such, but rather the institutionally legitimate ways in which professional judgement is made legible under assessment. Examination scripts matter for medical humanities because they make curricular normativity and evaluative pressure textually visible, showing how future clinicians are taught to write responsibility, uncertainty, and care into the same ethical scene. These repertoires also render an ableist prognostic imagination institutionally legible-one in which ventilator-dependent life is readily scripted in advance as a future to be avoided rather than supported-linking the temporal analysis to critical disability studies' account of the curative imaginary.

items.abstractZh: 医学生通常要接受伦理困难临床决策的考试，但考试答卷在医学人文领域很少被视为一种独特的实证对象。本文分析了61份匿名的丹麦医学生书面考试回答，内容涉及一位虚构的晚期肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）患者出现急性呼吸衰竭的情况。本研究被构建为对考试文本的体裁分析，通过反复细读、对反复出现的文本动作进行归纳编码，以及通过哈特穆特·罗萨的加速与共鸣概念进行溯因解释来操作化。识别出四种伦理剧目：加速稳定化；预后分诊与干预的界限；分布式责任与对合法暂停的寻求；以及通过关注意愿、尊严和姑息替代方案而形成的脆弱共鸣。在整个语料库中，学生们通过紧迫与延迟、可逆性与进展、升级与相称限制之间的时间区分来书写判断。这些发现并未展示专业精神本身，而是展示了在评估下专业判断得以被识读的制度化合法方式。考试答卷对医学人文具有重要意义，因为它们使课程规范性和评价压力在文本上可见，展示了未来临床医生如何被教导将责任、不确定性和关怀写入同一伦理场景。这些剧目还使一种能力主义的预后想象在制度上变得可识读——在这种想象中，依赖呼吸机的生活很容易被预先书写为一种应被避免而非支持的未来——从而将时间性分析与批判性残疾研究对治愈性想象的论述联系起来。
items.frontierRationale: 新近发表于医学人文期刊，聚焦ALS终末期呼吸决策的伦理教育，揭示临床判断形成中的时间性与能力主义预设，对ALS照护伦理和医学教育具有转化启示。

items.title: Sphingolipid remodeling in SPT-related neuropathies.
items.summary: Sphingolipid homeostasis is critical for structural and functional integrity of neurons in the central and peripheral nervous systems. Serine-palmitoyltransferase (SPT) is the first and the rate-limiting metabolic entry point into the de novo sphingolipid biosynthesis. Mutations in SPT subunits, SPTLC1 and SPTLC2 lead to contrasting patient phenotypes, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and hereditary sensory and autonomic neuropathy type 1 (HSAN1). A third mixed sensory-motor phenotype is attributed to distinct mutation sets in SPTLC1 and SPTLC2. However, a direct comparison of the metabolic consequences of mutations spanning these disease conditions has not been performed. Mixed sensory-motor mutants exhibit a third metabolic state, with elevated 1-deoxysphingolipid formation and, in contrast to HSAN1 variants, decreased feedback inhibition and increased canonical sphingolipid synthesis. Sphingolipid profiling reveals that ALS variants are characterized by preferential accumulation of dihydrosphingolipids and sphingolipid species containing C 18 -C 22 N-acyl chains, whereas very-long-chain (C 22 -C 26 ) 1-deoxysphingolipids predominate in HSAN1. The SPT-variants associated with mixed sensory-motor symptoms show elevated levels of both lipid types. Notably, the metabolic distinction is disease-specific and SPT subunit independent. The data support the view that segregated shifts in sphingolipid flux underlie divergence of clinical phenotypes in SPT-variants. These metabolic configurations generate testable predictions for therapy: L-serine supplementation may benefit HSAN1 but could prove counterproductive in ALS and sensory-motor disease conditions.

items.abstractZh: 鞘脂稳态对中枢和外周神经系统中神经元的结构和功能完整性至关重要。丝氨酸棕榈酰转移酶（SPT）是新生鞘脂生物合成的第一个和限速代谢入口。SPT亚基SPTLC1和SPTLC2的突变导致截然不同的患者表型，包括肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和遗传性感觉自主神经病1型（HSAN1）。第三种混合感觉运动表型归因于SPTLC1和SPTLC2中不同的突变集。然而，尚未对这些疾病条件下突变所导致的代谢后果进行直接比较。在此，我们证明SPTLC1和SPTLC2的ALS变异促进鞘脂合成增强，因为神经酰胺介导的稳态控制受损。相反，HSAN1变异显示底物选择性改变，有利于非经典1-脱氧鞘脂产生，同时保留经典反馈调节。混合感觉运动突变体表现出第三种代谢状态，1-脱氧鞘脂形成升高，与HSAN1变异相反，反馈抑制降低和经典鞘脂合成增加。鞘脂谱分析显示，ALS变异的特点是优先积累二氢鞘脂和含有C18-C22 N-酰基链的鞘脂种类，而超长链（C22-C26）1-脱氧鞘脂在HSAN1中占主导。与混合感觉运动症状相关的SPT变异显示两种脂质类型水平均升高。值得注意的是，代谢差异具有疾病特异性且不依赖于SPT亚基。数据支持以下观点：鞘脂通量的分离性变化是SPT变异临床表型差异的基础。这些代谢配置为治疗产生了可检验的预测：L-丝氨酸补充可能有益于HSAN1，但在ALS和感觉运动疾病条件下可能适得其反。
